task_modules.mount: fixed overhead sensor bar at y=20, x=6..10; three pull-cord/hand-crank controls; no floor posts
task_modules.under_blackout: free task use works; no store electrical buff or electric charge

task_modules.baffle_policy: first real 0.8s baffle folds toward player side and masks north-facing service position; sound continues outside the registered solid baffle, never global safe aura
task_modules.baffle_surface: raised panel on existing FX08 north countertop edge; blocks sound rays crossing this actual segment only

business_route_policy.raid_never_requires_chore_completion: Monster-specific original-object rules remain combat objectives; identical looking routine jobs are paused and not charged.
business_route_policy.evacuation: physical route to customer_exit; normal customer combat flag remains false and no paid receipt is invented

trap_placement.no_legal_cell: leave charge stored; retry at most once per world second, never force placement
trap_placement.after_raid: remove temporary instance without refund; paid traps untouched

combat_reference.guard: only same actual legal manifested root after rule; respect actual LOS/height/HP/DoT and real attack receipts

explicit_pairs.reason: one pursuer plus spatially isolated anchored hazard; no shared original item or work slot
one dangerous root and one passive no-reward anomaly; not two hostile pursuers

composition.power_modifier: real root-bound blackout may accompany a single admitted encounter only; no extra invisible root or reward; free manual task routes remain available
composition.on_late_invalid: stop new attacks from invalid root and rollback its uncommitted admission; do not erase already earned costs or clone task items

validation_limit: Grid routing and scripted object/action response are bounded reference evidence, not all 105 live AIs, arbitrary pair balance, mobile performance or playtest victory rates.

F17.protection_budget: immutable actual original route_distance / (base_speed * (1-global_slow_cap)) + 2s; never extends original encounter deadline
F17.actual_movement: current actual slow applies until its original absolute expiry; freeze/control cannot be cleared at response entry
F17.during_response: cancel only this root attacks; do not receive damage/control/overload feedback; other roots can still attack player
F17.hp_and_q: preserve current HP, permanent poison and all prepaid maturity receipts; finite effects expire by world time; no catch-up damage on exit
F17.precondition_lost: end protection immediately; keep actual travelled distance, valid completed work and spent budget; cannot rebind root/actor/parcel/route or refresh deadline
F17.completion: same original parcel really transfers to same actor after full 2 world seconds; main rule settles root once; following exit motion is harmless and cannot pay again
F17.counterexample: with q125, 25% of F17 max230 HP restores to57.5; 0.5*q*(1-.30)=43.75 per second suppresses again after2s, less than actual3/3.3+2=2.909s pickup travel+work; resetting pickup on suppression could deadlock
